user.description: Pick the Dimplex panel heater to add.

data_description.proxy_source: Recommended is preselected. Keeping the current proxy needs no PIN.
data_description.sync_clock: Sets the heater clock to Home Assistant's time when it is more than a minute off. Timer schedules run on the heater clock.

reauth_confirm.description: The heater rejected the saved PIN. Submit to pair it again.

pin_still_shown.title: PIN shown?
pin_still_shown.description: The PIN is still on the display.

pin.title: Enter PIN
pin.description: Type the 6-digit PIN shown on the heater.

data_description.passkey: Missed it? Leave empty to show it again.

pairing_failed.title: Pairing didn't start
pairing_failed.description: Submit to try again on the same proxy.

abort.no_heaters_found: No new Dimplex heater found. Close the Dimplex app and try again in a minute.
abort.not_dimplex: This is not a Dimplex heater.
abort.no_proxy: No Bluetooth proxy with the Dimplex firmware can reach this heater.{proxy_notes}

error.no_proxy: No Bluetooth proxy can reach this heater. Move it closer or check the proxy, then submit.
error.pin_rejected: Wrong PIN. Check the display and try again.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Submit the PIN again.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the heater. Submit to try again.
error.pairing_not_started: Pairing didn't start. Submit to try again.
error.proxies_busy: All proxies are busy — pairing will probably fail.

data_description.keep_connected: Turn off if this heater often stops responding. Each update then connects briefly (slower controls).
data_description.sync_clock: Sets the heater clock to Home Assistant's time when it is more than a minute off. Timer schedules run on the heater clock.
data_description.boost_minutes: How long the Boost preset heats at the heater's Boost temperature (1–240 min).

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Saves the periods to the chosen days of a timer programme on the heater. Each day is replaced and then read back.

days.name: Days
days.description: The days that get these periods.

periods.name: Periods
periods.description: Up to 4 heating periods. Leave empty for no heating periods that day.

get_gatt_services.name: List Bluetooth services (developer)
get_gatt_services.description: Developer diagnostic: lists the heater's Bluetooth services without reading values.

device_id.name: Heater
device_id.description: The Dimplex panel heater to inspect.

cannot_connect.message: Couldn't reach the heater. Check that its Bluetooth proxy is online and in range.

characteristic_unavailable.message: The heater doesn't support this operation.

protected_characteristic.message: This heater setting is blocked because changing it is unsafe.

invalid_gatt_request.message: Invalid value for this heater setting.

invalid_setpoint.message: Choose a whole number between {min} and {max} °C.

invalid_preset.message: This heater doesn't support that preset.

setpoint_unavailable.message: The heater hasn't reported its temperature range yet. Try again shortly.

reauth_required.message: The heater rejected the saved PIN. Open the repair to pair it again.

responder_missing.message: The heater's Bluetooth proxy lacks the Dimplex PIN firmware. Install it (see README), then reload.

invalid_hvac_mode.message: This heater supports Heat and Auto only.

temperature_needs_heat.message: In Auto the schedule sets the temperature. Switch to Heat first.

away_until_required.message: Set a future "Away return time" first (enable that entity on the heater's device page if hidden).

invalid_away_until.message: The Away return time must be in the future.

setting_unavailable.message: The heater hasn't reported this setting yet. Try again shortly.

invalid_temperature_offset.message: Choose an offset between {min} and {max} °C in steps of 0.1 °C.

advance_requires_timer.message: Advance works only in User Timer, Home All Day or Out All Day.

away_temperature_needs_away.message: Turn on Away first by setting an Away return time, then change the Away temperature.

boost_unavailable.message: This heater has no valid Boost temperature.

schedule_not_saved.message: The heater didn't keep the new schedule. Try again.

schedule_partly_saved.message: Saved {saved} of {total} days before the heater stopped responding. Run the action again.

heater_stalled.title: {name} stopped responding
heater_stalled.description: The heater's Bluetooth has stopped. Switch the heater off and on at the wall; Home Assistant reconnects automatically.
